name: HubSpot Contact Social Profile Enrichment Bridge (dhRobin Systems)

parameters.content:
## n8n-hubspot-contact-social-profile-enrichment-bridge
**dhRobin Systems** · HubSpot contacts → licensed social-graph lookup → identity-checked, validated, diffed → HubSpot batch update.

**Safe by default.** With no environment variables set:
- `SANDBOX_MODE=true`: synthetic contacts and provider. **Zero external calls.**
- `DRY_RUN=true`: updates are computed, nothing is written.
- `SYNC_TO_HUBSPOT=false`: CRM writes need an explicit opt-in.

**Never overwrite with less:** empty or invalid provider values cannot replace existing HubSpot data. Use a licensed enrichment provider; do not point this at scraped sources.

### Pinned synthetic payloads
Pinned: schedule, webhook, contact search, contact batch read, Social Graph lookup (7 responses in selection order), HubSpot batch update.

Pins apply to **manual executions only**; production runs ignore them. Unpin a node before a manual live test of that integration.

nodes.name: Enrichment Scan Schedule
nodes.notes: Every 2 hours at :23. Each run processes up to MAX_CONTACTS_PER_RUN.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Contact Change Webhook
nodes.notes: Subscribe to contact.creation and contact.propertyChange (email, profile URL). Responds 200 immediately.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Typed, non-secret configuration under config.*; webhook request fields pass through.

nodes.name: Resolve Trigger & Verify Webhook
nodes.notes: scan vs. webhook mode, v3 signature, loop guard, de-duplication.

nodes.name: Mock Contact Retrieval
nodes.notes: Nine fictitious contacts, one per path.

nodes.name: No Webhook Contacts: End
nodes.notes: See counters on Resolve Trigger & Verify Webhook.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: $('Config & Safety Gate').first().json.config.contactProperties, inputs: $('Resolve Trigger & Verify Webhook').first().json.contactIds.slice(0, 100).map(id => ({ id })) }) }}

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Read Contacts
nodes.notes: Webhook mode: reads the changed contacts (≤ 100 per event batch). Scope: crm.objects.contacts.read.

nodes.name: Build Contact Search Request
nodes.notes: Never checked OR checked before RESCAN_DAYS, optional lifecycle filter.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Contacts
nodes.notes: Scan mode: stops paging once MAX_CONTACTS_PER_RUN is covered.

nodes.name: Select Contacts for Enrichment
nodes.notes: Opt-out, identifiers, personal-email minimisation, recheck window, cap.

nodes.name: No Eligible Contacts: End
nodes.notes: See stats on Select Contacts for Enrichment.

nodes.name: Social Graph: Lookup Profile
nodes.notes: BATCH_SIZE requests per RATE_LIMIT_DELAY_MS. Retries 429/5xx; per-contact failures continue and are retried next run.

nodes.name: Mock Social Graph
nodes.notes: Offline provider responses in the documented contract.

nodes.name: Normalize & Diff Evaluator
nodes.notes: Identity checks, avatar/history validation, protected diff.

// Emit one item per HubSpot batch update (≤ 100 contacts each).
return $('Compose Update Batches & Run Stats').first().json.updateBatches.map((inputs, batchIndex) => ({ json: { batchIndex, inputs } }));

nodes.name: Log Run Stats
nodes.notes: Final summary on every path, also written to the n8n log.
